description: This file defines the omi::OmiProxy class, which implements the IOmiProxy interface. It provides methods for mounting and unmounting encrypted bundles, and for registering and unregistering error listeners. The file includes licensing information and include guards.

classes.name: OmiProxy
classes.description: A class implementing the IOmiProxy interface, providing methods for managing encrypted bundles and error listeners.

methods.name: mountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Mounts an encrypted bundle given its ID, root filesystem path, and configuration JSON path. Returns true on success.

methods.name: umountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Unmounts the encrypted bundle identified by its ID. Returns true on success.

methods.name: registerListener
methods.description: Registers an error listener and returns a handle (unsigned long) for the registration.

methods.name: unregisterListener
methods.description: Unregisters an error listener identified by its tag.
